description: Hand-author the complete vidyqor/ Frappe app Python package: package files (hooks.py, modules.txt, patches.txt, __init__.py), support subpackages (config/api/services/utils/templates/www), the 18 snake_case module folders each with a doctype/ placeholder, the tests package with a FrappeTestCase smoke test, and the real SVG logo asset. Minimal stubs only, NO doctypes, NO ERP business logic. Grounded in live frappe/crm and frappe/frappe_docs conventions (see context.json). This FEAT is self-contained and must leave the package byte-compilable without Frappe installed; FEAT-002 (repo meta/automation/docs/README) depends on the paths this FEAT creates (logo asset, package layout, __version__).
steps: Read /home/om/Tools/Vidyqor/.agents/tasks/scaffold-plan.md and context.json FIRST; context.json replaces re-exploration.

Create vidyqor/hooks.py: module-level app_name='vidyqor', app_title='Vidyqor', app_publisher='Vidyqor Community', app_description (Education ERP, tagline 'One Platform. Every Institution.'), app_license='mit', required_apps=[], plus the standard large COMMENTED hook scaffolding block (includes, home pages, installation, doc_events, scheduler_events, testing, overrides) mirroring frappe_docs/hooks.py style. For the contact, use a comment pointing to GitHub reporting rather than an invented email.

Create vidyqor/modules.txt with the 18 Title Case module names, one per line, in the order given in context.json (Institution Management ... System Configuration), no trailing blank lines beyond one newline.
Create vidyqor/patches.txt containing only a header comment (e.g. '# Patches are applied in order; none yet for the foundation scaffold.'), no patch entries.

Create vidyqor/config/__init__.py, vidyqor/config/desktop.py (get_data() returning a list of module-config dicts for the app's desktop, or an empty list stub), vidyqor/config/docs.py (docs source config stub with source_link/docs_base_url/headline placeholders as comments or minimal values).
Create vidyqor/api/__init__.py, vidyqor/services/__init__.py, vidyqor/utils/__init__.py each with a one-line module docstring describing its purpose.

Create the 18 module folders in snake_case (institution_management, student_management, admission_management, academic_management, department_management, faculty_management, attendance_management, examination_management, finance_and_fee_management, library_management, hostel_management, transport_management, placement_management, human_resource_management, communication_management, document_management, reports_and_analytics, system_configuration); each gets __init__.py (may be empty or a docstring) and doctype/__init__.py (empty placeholder). NO doctype JSON, NO doctype subfolders beyond doctype/.

Create vidyqor/tests/__init__.py and vidyqor/tests/test_smoke.py: use 'from frappe.tests.utils import FrappeTestCase' inside the class module but ensure the module still BYTE-COMPILES without frappe installed (compileall only parses, does not import, so a top-level import is fine for compileall; keep the test body trivial, e.g. assert vidyqor.__version__ == '0.1.0'). Add a module docstring noting Frappe is required to RUN it.
Create vidyqor/public/.gitkeep (empty) and vidyqor/public/images/vidyqor-logo.svg: a real, minimal, valid geometric SVG using deep navy/blue/white/cyan (well-formed XML, <svg xmlns=... viewBox=...>).
acceptance_criteria: python3 -m compileall vidyqor exits 0 (all package Python byte-compiles without Frappe installed).
vidyqor/modules.txt contains exactly 18 non-empty lines in the required Title Case order.
ls -d vidyqor/*/doctype | wc -l returns 18 (every module folder has a doctype/ subfolder).
vidyqor/public/images/vidyqor-logo.svg exists and parses as well-formed XML.
hooks.py sets required_apps = [] and app_license = 'mit'; no invented email present.
No doctype JSON files and no ERP business logic were created.
verification: python3 -c "lines=[l for l in open('vidyqor/modules.txt').read().splitlines() if l.strip()]; assert len(lines)==18, lines; print('modules ok', len(lines))"
bash -c 'test $(ls -d vidyqor/*/doctype 2>/dev/null | wc -l) -eq 18 && echo "18 doctype dirs ok"'
python3 -c "import xml.dom.minidom as m; m.parse('vidyqor/public/images/vidyqor-logo.svg'); print('svg ok')"
python3 -c "import re; s=open('vidyqor/__init__.py').read(); assert '0.1.0' in s; print('version ok')"
Do NOT run Frappe tests (no Frappe environment, Option B).
findings: FEAT-001 complete. Package layout for FEAT-002 to reference: (1) Logo asset confirmed at vidyqor/public/images/vidyqor-logo.svg (128x128 viewBox 0 0 128 128, deep-navy #0b1f3a background, blue #1d4ed8/#2563eb and cyan #22d3ee geometric facets, white #ffffff center) — well-formed XML, this is the ONLY image asset; README/docs must reference only this path. (2) __version__ = "0.1.0" lives in vidyqor/__init__.py (single line, double-quoted) — flit [tool.flit.module] name="vidyqor" + [project] dynamic=["version"] will read it; CHANGELOG/release tag must match v0.1.0. (3) App identity from hooks.py: app_name='vidyqor', app_title='Vidyqor', app_publisher='Vidyqor Community', app_license='mit', required_apps=[] (no ERPNext/Education/HRMS/CRM dependency); no email anywhere — contact via GitHub Security Advisories + Issues/Discussions. (4) modules.txt has the 18 Title Case modules; 18 snake_case module folders each with doctype/__init__.py placeholder (no doctype JSON). (5) Support subpackages present: config (__init__, desktop.py get_data()->[], docs.py), api, services, utils, templates (docstring __init__), www/.gitkeep, public/.gitkeep, tests/{__init__,test_smoke.py}. (6) tests/test_smoke.py uses FrappeTestCase (top-level import frappe.tests.utils) — byte-compiles via compileall but REQUIRES a Frappe env to run; not executed here (Option B). (7) Verification all green: python3 -m compileall vidyqor exit 0; modules.txt=18 lines; 18 doctype dirs; SVG parses as XML; version 0.1.0 present. __pycache__ artifacts were removed after compile (no .gitignore exists yet — FEAT-002 should add one ignoring __pycache__/*.pyc).
